review_basis: Direct inspection of the final three original-resolution 20-mass PNG boards after legal-envelope-first generation and same-source legal/FAR/parking evaluation.

neighborhood.improvement: 20/20, 18 BOOK principles, 18 measured visual languages and all six p.3 scopes survive the same-source hard gates; ribbon, branch, split and stepback families are visibly distinct.
neighborhood.failure: The board still overuses elongated bar and folded/terrace chassis; the folded sequence in cells 04/07/10/13/18/20 and several long bars retain strong family resemblance.

gymnasium.improvement: 20/20, 14 BOOK principles, 18 measured visual languages and all six p.3 scopes survive; ridge, folded, sawtooth/daylight-monitor, stepped-section and carved-entry relations appear as real geometry.
gymnasium.failure: Most alternatives still begin from a low rectangular long-span hall chassis; roof and entry modifiers are real but do not yet create enough plan/section archetype changes for competition-grade variety.

cultural.improvement: 20/20, 16 BOOK principles, 18 measured visual languages and all six p.3 scopes survive; court-bridge, split-gallery-ramp and carved-gallery-spine families remain distinguishable.
cultural.failure: The set is still dominated by low gallery boxes and stepped bar assemblies; void/court relations vary but the overall museum chassis remains too repetitive.

verdict: Numeric BOOK/program diagnostics and same-source legal/FAR/parking hard constraints pass 60/60, but direct PNG review still rejects an architectural competition-grade claim because program-internal chassis repetition remains visible.
